sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA's official domain publishes the notice resuming e-Visa issuance; direct retrieval is currently Cloudflare-blocked but the page remains live and indexed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Starting from February 19, 2025, the MFA resumes issuance of e-Visas for foreigners from 45 countries.

sources.title: Decree No. 921/2025 extending visa-free entry for UK citizens
sources.publisher: Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine legislation portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The official legislation portal identifies the Presidential Decree as in force and records entry into force on 12 December 2025.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: operative electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: The registered operative e-Visa requirements expressly name this 42-passport Annex 3 cohort. Actual electronic issuance resumed on 19 February 2025; the listed route is an advance eVisa, not portal inference.
conditions: This is the directly named ordinary-passport Annex 3 cohort in the in-force legal schedule; no eligibility is inferred from omission, portal availability, or an unenumerated country count.
MFA resumed electronic issuance on 19 February 2025. The 25 March 2025 amendment removed Grenada, Peru, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, leaving these 42 directly named routes.

The advance e-Visa is single or double entry for up to 30 days within the listed visitor purposes. Residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, emergency, refugee, stateless, carrier, and final-admission treatment are not established here.

policies.title: United Kingdom ordinary passports: temporary visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Presidential Decree No. 921/2025 extends the United Kingdom citizen visa waiver through 30 January 2027 for stays up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The decree applies to citizens of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for entry and transit, limited to 90 days in any 180-day period.
This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline only; it does not establish work, residence, special-document, border-access, carrier, security, or final-admission treatment.
